## 镜头 5：减速弯 T7（右）（5 秒）

- 弯道：T7 右 约 70°，减速弯前半
- 海拔：42 m → 41 m
- 速度：约 300 → 95 km/h

**运行前** 先把挑好的关键帧放进 `input/`：首帧 `dream8_K4.png`，尾帧 `dream8_K5.png`。文件不存在时 LoadImage 会报 *value not in list*。

点一次 **运行** 生成 2 条候选，视频保存在 `output/video/dream8/`，文件名形如 `shot_05_t1_00001_.mp4`。

挑出最好的一条，复制为拼接脚本读取的文件：

```
mkdir -p output/video/dream8/selected
cp output/video/dream8/shot_05_t1_00001_.mp4 output/video/dream8/selected/shot_05.mp4
```

Hard braking at the end of the short straight, the nose dipping hard as the speed falls from about 300 to 95 km/h; the road stays straight while braking, with no left turn before the corner. Then the driver turns the steering wheel hard to the RIGHT and the car turns sharply RIGHT through a tight corner of about seventy degrees, clipping the red-and-white kerb on the inside right. The view rotates far to the right and the whole scenery swings steadily to the left across the frame, so that the road the car was on disappears off the left edge. The shot ends just out of this right-hander, with a tight left-hand corner close ahead. Only one turn in this shot, and it is to the RIGHT. Single continuous take from the same onboard camera, no cuts, no camera switch, the car always moves forward and never reverses, no on-screen text, no watermark. Visual style: Photorealistic onboard racing footage filmed by a T-cam mounted just above and behind the driver's helmet of a dark-blue open-wheel single-seater race car with a white nose. Only the halo safety bar, the top of the cockpit and the front wing tips are visible at the bottom of the frame; the camera height and framing never change. Sunny afternoon, clear blue sky, warm consistent sunlight. Grey asphalt circuit with white edge lines, red-and-white striped kerbs on every corner, green grass run-off, blue barrier walls, rolling green hills and scattered trees in the distance. Cinematic, sharp, natural colours, 16:9. No on-screen text, no logos, no watermark.
